Index objects the store already holds, without a rebuild

```sh
goback [global flags] index <command>
```

## index commits

Indexes them by set in receipt order as a rebuild does, those that name no set under a placeholder set; refuses the lot if one is not a commit, is tombstoned or already indexed

```sh
goback [global flags] index commits [flags]
```

| Flag | Description | Environment | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--refs-file value` | file of commit refs, one hex ref per line |  |  |
| `--dry-run` | write nothing, report what would be done |  |  |
